decision: Did not close. The work is tenant-performed garden tidy with no spend and no contractor, and the agency has already treated it as finished (event-022, event-023) — but two things stop a clean closure: the completion photos are not on the ticket (the tenant's reply at event-020 could not be parsed, no attachment visible), and three chasers (event-011, event-016, event-017) ask about the garden at "Flat 2, 72 Lantern Quay, Eastmere, ZZ4 0ZZ" while the ticket and address block say Flat 4, 174 Beacon Close, Westmarsh. I recorded the conflict (ACT-1), referred the address discrepancy to the office rather than picking a side with a party (ACT-2), asked the tenant the single tenant-owned question — which garden the completed work and photos cover (ACT-3) — and put the case on hold for the tenant (ACT-4). No approval, dispatch or spend was needed or taken: no contractor is involved and no cost falls on the landlord.
